rationale: As a wholesale distributor with 20,000+ SKUs serving sign manufacturers and large-format graphics companies, the VP of Product Management owns portfolio strategy, vendor selection, and product line expansion decisions. This role would care about Tedlar because: (1) Adding a premium protective film with 12-20+ year outdoor lifespan differentiates GSG's offering in a competitive distribution market, enabling them to win higher-margin business from quality-focused sign manufacturers; (2) Tedlar's proven durability and UV protection reduce warranty claims and customer complaints that flow back through the distribution channel, improving GSG's reputation and customer retention; (3) With GSG actively promoting application tapes and overlaminates (RTape partnerships) at ISA Sign Expo, Tedlar represents a natural portfolio extension that complements existing product lines and strengthens their position as a one-stop-shop for premium graphics solutions; (4) The recent Grimco acquisition creates opportunity to establish Tedlar across a combined distribution network, and this role drives those portfolio integration decisions. Their KPIs around gross margin improvement, supplier partnerships, and market share growth align directly with introducing a differentiated, premium-positioned protective film.

With $207M in revenue, 10 locations across 16 states, and 20,000+ SKUs, the Director of Procurement manages supplier relationships, negotiates contracts, and optimizes the supply chain that keeps GSG's distribution network stocked. This role would care about Tedlar because: (1) Supplier reliability and product quality directly impact GSG's ability to serve sign manufacturers and graphics companies without backorders or quality complaints—Tedlar's 60+ years of proven performance and DuPont backing provides supply chain stability; (2) Total cost of ownership matters in distribution: While Tedlar may have premium positioning, its extreme durability (12-20+ years) means GSG's customers need fewer replacements, reducing GSG's inventory turnover costs and logistics expenses over time; (3) The recent Grimco acquisition (January 2025) likely triggered procurement consolidation initiatives—this is the exact window when new supplier relationships are evaluated and rationalized, making now the optimal time to introduce Tedlar as a strategic vendor; (4) Customer service metrics tied to this role improve when GSG stocks products that solve end-user pain points (UV damage, graffiti, premature failure)—Tedlar reduces complaint escalations and return processing. Their KPIs around supplier performance, inventory turns, and procurement cost savings align with adding a reliable, premium supplier that enhances customer satisfaction.

GSG's sales organization serves sign manufacturers, large-format print companies, and vehicle wrap installers across 16 states—customers who directly experience the pain points Tedlar solves. The VP of Sales would care about Tedlar because: (1) Salespeople need differentiated products to win competitive deals and justify premium pricing—Tedlar's graffiti resistance, 12-20+ year outdoor lifespan, and UV protection provide concrete value propositions that help GSG's sales team close business against commodity-focused distributors; (2) Customer retention and account growth depend on solving real problems: When GSG's sign manufacturer customers face warranty claims from premature film failure or graffiti vandalism, Tedlar becomes a solution the sales team can proactively offer, deepening relationships and expanding wallet share; (3) GSG exhibits at ISA Sign Expo (2025 Booth #3325) and PRINTING United—the VP of Sales owns trade show strategy and needs premium products to showcase that attract qualified buyers and generate leads; (4) Sales team training and enablement around Tedlar's technical advantages (weather resistance -70°F to 230°F, no yellowing/cracking) equips reps to have consultative conversations with quality-focused customers, elevating GSG's position from transactional distributor to trusted advisor. Their KPIs around revenue growth, customer acquisition, and account penetration improve when the sales team can offer industry-leading protective films that solve high-value customer problems.
